name: Tiny AI XO 107601
author: Beck Sarbassov
training: Browser outcome-weighted policy gradients, Adam and bounded replay after completed games
training_origin: Imported unchanged from the published Sites release: 316 self-play games and 2 human games. No training was run during this integration.
startup_policy: Personal saves always take precedence, including zero-game saves. Fresh browsers use the bundled 318-game checkpoint. Learning remains local, not collectively synchronized.
